title: Finite initial truncation of the opposite simplicial indexing category
statement: Let $S$ be a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] such that every $S_n$ is finite and nonempty and $S$ has finitely many nondegenerate simplices. Define a category $\mathcal I_S$ whose objects are pairs $(n,s)$ with $s\in S_n$, and whose morphisms $(m,t)\to(n,s)$ are order-preserving maps $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ satisfying $S(\varphi)(s)=t$. Choose $m_0\geq0$ such that every simplex in degree $n>m_0$ is degenerate, and let $\mathcal I_{S,\leq r}$ be the full subcategory on objects $(n,s)$ with $n\leq r$. Then the finite full subcategory $\mathcal I_{S,\leq 2m_0}^{\mathrm{op}}$ is initial in $\mathcal I_S^{\mathrm{op}}$ in these explicit senses: (1) for every object $z$ of $\mathcal I_S$ there is an object $y$ of $\mathcal I_{S,\leq 2m_0}$ and a morphism $z\to y$ in $\mathcal I_S$; (2) for any two morphisms $z\to y$ and $z\to y'$ with $y,y'$ in $\mathcal I_{S,\leq 2m_0}$, there are objects $y=y_0,y_1,\ldots,y_{2r}=y'$ in $\mathcal I_{S,\leq 2m_0}$ and a zigzag $y_0\to y_1\leftarrow y_2\to\cdots\leftarrow y_{2r}$ in $\mathcal I_S$, together with morphisms $z\to y_i$ extending the two given ones, such that composing $z\to y_i$ with each adjacent arrow gives $z\to y_{i+1}$ (or conversely for an arrow pointing left). Consequently, for every category $\mathcal C$ and diagram $D:\mathcal I_S^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$, Categories Lemma 002R identifies the limit of $D$ over $\mathcal I_S^{\mathrm{op}}$ with the limit of its restriction to the finite category $\mathcal I_{S,\leq 2m_0}^{\mathrm{op}}$, whenever either limit exists.
